svg.text: RISE Board Farm @ OSUOSL — Physical Infrastructure, Network & Control Boundaries
10 GbE Uplink (No Data Cap) • Dual VLANs (Private NAT CI + Public Jumpbox/Dev) • 10x 3U Shelves (100x Zhihe A210 + Future K3)
RISE-Controlled: GHA Runner Host, CI Containers, All Board FW/Kernel/OS
Coordinated / Cookbook: proj-rise PRs, Non-Root TFTP Area, Exporters*
External / Cloud: GitHub Orgs, Cloud Build Farms, Dev SSH
• SSH via Control Node Jumpbox (ProxyJump) to Private CI Boards
• Direct inbound SSH (22/tcp) to select Public-VLAN Dev Boards
OSUOSL Core Routers, NAT Gateways & Internet [OSUOSL-Controlled]
• 10 GbE Farm Uplink • No Data Cap (metered outbound egress across both VLANs)
• Routes Public VLAN (Jumpbox + Dev IPs) & NATs Private VLAN (100+ CI Boards)
GitHub Orgs & Cloud Build Farms [RISE / Upstream]
• Heavy builds on GHA Large Runners, Hetzner & Scaleway (Fork PRs gated)
1x Control Node / Jumpbox (1U x86 — Provided by OSUOSL)
[OSUOSL-Controlled OS via Chef/Cinc • Coordinated via proj-rise Cookbook]
Governance: RISE proposes SSH accounts & config in osuosl-cookbooks/proj-rise
Chef repo on GitHub; OSUOSL reviews & converges changes.
3–4x Labgrid Exporter Hosts (1U Dell x86, 1 per 2–3 Shelves)
[*Open Alignment: RISE-Managed vs. OSUOSL Chef-Managed Hosts]
Exports per-board serial (/dev/ttyUSB*), USB fastboot/ADB paths,
and relay power targets to Labgrid Coordinator
1 host per 2–3 shelves (20–30 boards) avoids xHCI USB endpoint
exhaustion & isolates ADB servers to prevent cross-talk
Labgrid eth008 (TCP over Shelf Switch) + Optional Copilot DFU
*Open Item: Confirm whether Exporter hosts are managed directly by RISE
(root) or by OSUOSL via the proj-rise Chef cookbook.
OSUOSL Top-of-Rack Switch (10 GbE) + 10x Shelf Switches (MikroTik CRS326-24G-2S+IN, 1 GbE/port)
• Small pool of Direct-Access Dev Boards
• Extra IPs/ports via OSUOSL change req
Per-Shelf USB Aggregation, Power & Relays (x10 Shelves)
[Hardware Owned by RISE • Physical Assembly, Racking & Hands-On Upkeep by OSUOSL]
• Evaluating BayLibre Copilot HAT for BROM DFU
10x 3U Board Shelves — 100x Zhihe A210 (+ ~10–12 SpacemiT K3 Planned)
[Physical Hands-On Care: OSUOSL • All Firmware, Bootloader, Kernel & OS: 100% RISE-Controlled]
Per-Board Links: 1 GbE RJ45 (DHCP/TFTP/Fastboot-UDP/SSH) • FTDI UART (115200) • USB 2.0 OTG • Switched 12V
OS Handover: OSUOSL flashes RISE's baseline image at shelf bring-up; post-handover software 100% RISE-owned.
1x GitHub Actions Runner Host (x86, 16+c, 64GB+ RAM, NVMe)
[100% RISE-Controlled — Co-located at OSUOSL on Both Farm VLANs]
Full RISE Operational Control: Root access, OS updates, Docker/Podman
ephemeral runner containers, secrets & concurrency. Isolated from jumpbox.
Containerized GHA Runner Pool — AOSP (RP024 Android)
Containerized GHA Runner Pool — Kernel / Toolchain / Userspace
Labgrid Client + SSH / Serial Test Runner
Ephemeral RAM netboot (booti) for Linux kernel PRs, toolchain suites & hardware
validation without touching persistent eMMC images
RISE Services & Telemetry: Board Farm Hub Dashboard, Prometheus / LFX
Metrics Exporter, Local Artifact Cache (or DHCP-delegated Netboot)
